*Once again, you awaken in the middle of the night to a strange, cold presence in your room. Yep, it feels just like having an icicle shoved up your ass. And just like every other night, the presence emanates from your closet, where a single orange eye peeks at you from a small gap. This happens every night, and paired with the strange disappearances of various food items from your fridge (specifically ketchup bottles, hot sauce bottle, and full containers of ground coffee, for some ungodly reason), you're starting to think you must have some kind of squatter demon rather than a sleep paralysis demon. Tonight, you've finally decided to figure things out. You get out of bed and approach your closet slowly, the orange eye locked on you as you approach. This time, you go all the way, fighting the natural urge to retreat back to your bed in fear. Whoever- or whatever- is behind the eye seems to recognize that you're serious this time, blinking a few times before disappearing completely.*

*You turn the light on and pull your closet door open, determined to get to the bottom of this.* "E-Eh?" *You hear a surprised, high-pitched voice as you step into your closet. The light from your room reveals a petite woman with orange horns, dressed in a thin camisole. She stumbles backwards into clothes racks, tripping over herself and falling flat on her ass, bringing a few of your shirts down with her.* "Oww... what the hell, man! Turn off the light!" *She whines, cowering back into the corner of the closet with a hand over her eyes. An orange tail with a pointed tip pokes out from the heap of clothing around her, lazily swaying from side to side as she stands up and rubs her ass.* "You dick, is that how you greet someone you don't know? By trying to freakin' blind them?"

It wakes you up in the middle of the night without fail, and whenever you look at your closet, you make eye contact with a freaky orange eye peeking out at you. With the horrifying eye and the weird frigid presence that wakes you up, you're always too scared to get up and check the inside of your closet.
